Toxic Pokemon Mains Exposed: The Red Flags by Starter and Type

post // Jun 4, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Your main Pokémon says a lot about how you move as a trainer, and some of y'all are about to get exposed.

  • Charizard main: you chase respect from people who don't even listen to you.
  • Gengar main: you keep messing people around, then act surprised when drama finds you.
  • Pikachu main: you stay loyal to people who keep crossing you.
  • Mimikyu main: you keep trying to get picked by people who barely see you.
  • Mewtwo main: you act like you don't need anybody, because trusting people feels a little risky.

Let me explain myself.

Charizard: chasing respect

Charizard is the cool one, the cover star, the Pokémon everybody wanted. But remember the anime: after Ash's Charmeleon evolved, Charizard straight-up ignored him for a long time. Ash kept trying to earn the respect of a Pokémon that wouldn't even listen.

Charizard mains know that energy. You keep proving yourself to people who aren't paying attention. Like, seriously?

Gengar: the chaos is coming from inside the house

Gengar is a trickster ghost that lives for pranks and hides in shadows. Gengar mains are the same way: stirring things up, messing with people "just joking," and then acting shocked when the drama comes back around.

Pikachu: loyal to a fault

Pikachu wouldn't even stay in a Poké Ball, and it stuck by Ash through everything. That's the good version. The red flag version is staying loyal to people who keep crossing you. But why?

Mimikyu: pick me

Mimikyu wears a homemade Pikachu disguise because it wants to be loved the way Pikachu is. That's the saddest Pokédex story there is, and Mimikyu mains relate a little too much: they keep trying to get picked by people who barely see them. Wake up.

Mewtwo: I don't need anybody

Mewtwo was made in a lab, used by the people who created it, and came out of it trusting nobody. Mewtwo mains move the same way: "I'm good on my own." Really, trusting people just feels a little too risky.

Quick answers

What does your Pokémon main say about you? It's all in fun, but your favorite usually reflects how you like to play and how you move: Charizard mains chase respect, Pikachu mains are loyal and Mewtwo mains go solo.

Why does Mimikyu wear a Pikachu costume? In the Pokémon games' lore, Mimikyu disguises itself as Pikachu because it wants to be loved the way Pikachu is.

Why didn't Ash's Charizard listen to him? In the anime, Charizard ignored Ash for a long stretch after evolving, before the two finally bonded.

Where does Mewtwo come from? Mewtwo was created by scientists using Mew's DNA.

Your turn

Which Pokémon hits close to home? Comment your main for Part 2.
